shortDescription: Quanta Services NYSE:PWR rises 1.5% in Thursday's trading as Bernstein upgraded the infrastructure services company to Outperform from Market Perform with a $775 price target, bumped up from $748, saying the stock's valuation has declined sharply even as the fundamental backdrop has improved.Quanta…

children: rises 1.5% in Thursday's trading as Bernstein upgraded the infrastructure services company to Outperform from Market Perform with a $775 price target, bumped up from $748, saying the stock's valuation has declined sharply even as the fundamental backdrop has improved.

shares have lagged the S&P by 15% since late June, and the P/E multiple hascompressed by 30% from the peak to ~32x as the market priced in concerns over credit, politics, and regulation; at the current valuation, the premium to non-AI industrials is ~10 points below its four-year average, suggesting the stock already discounts some of the concerns, Bernstein's Chad Dillard said.

The data center construction bottleneck is shifting from megawatts to manpower, the analyst said, and as labor scarcity increases, customers increasingly value certainty of craft availability, which should concentrate more work with scaled contractors such as Quanta
, which is growing its labor pool at a 14% compound annual growth rate, 4x faster than the industry and 2x faster organically.

The outlook for power demand is stronger today than a year ago, and faster load growth means more grid spending, Dillard said, noting that 2% load growth has coincided with 12% utility capital spending growth and 14% organic growth for Quanta's
electrical segment; with load growth moving toward 3%, the analyst expects utility capex and Quanta's revenue growth to step up.

title: Quanta Services upgraded at Bernstein as sharp pullback creates entry point
